# Parallel Threshold Policy Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Finish `src/dispatch.rs` by adding the centralized parallel-threshold policy (`should_parallelize()` plus default threshold constant storage) and integrating it into `select_exec_path()`.

**Architecture:** `dispatch.rs` remains the single internal owner of execution-path admission, combining three concerns in one place: `ExecPath`, `ParallelGuard`, and global threshold policy with a non-contiguous penalty multiplier.

**Tech Stack:** Rust, compile-time constants, crate-internal helper functions

**Prerequisites:** W9T2 (`ParallelGuard`) must be complete.

```rust
use std::cell::Cell;

thread_local! {
    static PARALLEL_DEPTH: Cell<usize> = const { Cell::new(0) };
}

pub(crate) const DEFAULT_PARALLEL_THRESHOLD: usize = 16_384;
pub(crate) const NON_CONTIGUOUS_PARALLEL_PENALTY: usize = 2;

/// Internal execution-path decision used by semantic modules.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub(crate) enum ExecPath {
    Serial,
    Simd,
    Parallel,
}

/// Private token propagated through library-managed parallel regions.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub(crate) struct ParallelContext {
    _private: (),
}

/// Nested-parallel admission guard.
#[derive(Debug)]
pub(crate) struct ParallelGuard {
    entered: bool,
}

impl ParallelGuard {
    pub(crate) fn enter() -> Option<Self> {
        PARALLEL_DEPTH.with(|depth| {
            if depth.get() == 0 {
                depth.set(1);
                Some(Self { entered: true })
            } else {
                None
            }
        })
    }

    pub(crate) fn context(&self) -> ParallelContext {
        ParallelContext { _private: () }
    }
}

impl Drop for ParallelGuard {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        if self.entered {
            PARALLEL_DEPTH.with(|depth| depth.set(0));
        }
    }
}

pub(crate) fn should_parallelize(len: usize, is_f_contiguous: bool) -> bool {
    let effective_threshold = if is_f_contiguous {
        DEFAULT_PARALLEL_THRESHOLD
    } else {
        DEFAULT_PARALLEL_THRESHOLD * NON_CONTIGUOUS_PARALLEL_PENALTY
    };

    len >= effective_threshold
}

/// Chooses the current execution path.
pub(crate) fn select_exec_path(
    len: usize,
    is_f_contiguous: bool,
    alignment_ok: bool,
) -> ExecPath {
    if should_parallelize(len, is_f_contiguous) {
        if let Some(guard) = ParallelGuard::enter() {
            let _context = guard.context();
            return ExecPath::Parallel;
        }
    }

    if len != 0 && is_f_contiguous && alignment_ok {
        ExecPath::Simd
    } else {
        ExecPath::Serial
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::{
        select_exec_path,
        should_parallelize,
        ExecPath,
        ParallelGuard,
        DEFAULT_PARALLEL_THRESHOLD,
    };

    #[test]
    fn test_select_exec_path_serial_small_input() {
        assert_eq!(select_exec_path(8, false, false), ExecPath::Serial);
        assert_eq!(select_exec_path(0, true, true), ExecPath::Serial);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_select_exec_path_simd_contiguous_aligned() {
        assert_eq!(select_exec_path(256, true, true), ExecPath::Simd);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_select_exec_path_non_contiguous_penalized() {
        assert_eq!(select_exec_path(256, false, true), ExecPath::Serial);
        assert_eq!(select_exec_path(256, true, false), ExecPath::Serial);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_parallel_guard_first_entry_succeeds() {
        let guard = ParallelGuard::enter();
        assert!(guard.is_some());
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_parallel_guard_nested_entry_fails() {
        let _guard = ParallelGuard::enter().expect("first entry must succeed");
        assert!(ParallelGuard::enter().is_none());
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_parallel_guard_drop_releases_context() {
        {
            let _guard = ParallelGuard::enter().expect("first entry must succeed");
            assert!(ParallelGuard::enter().is_none());
        }

        assert!(ParallelGuard::enter().is_some());
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_select_exec_path_falls_back_on_nested_parallel() {
        let _guard = ParallelGuard::enter().expect("first entry must succeed");
        assert_eq!(select_exec_path(DEFAULT_PARALLEL_THRESHOLD, true, true), ExecPath::Simd);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_should_parallelize_small_input_false() {
        assert!(!should_parallelize(DEFAULT_PARALLEL_THRESHOLD - 1, true));
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_should_parallelize_large_input_true() {
        assert!(should_parallelize(DEFAULT_PARALLEL_THRESHOLD, true));
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_should_parallelize_non_contiguous_threshold_doubled() {
        assert!(!should_parallelize(DEFAULT_PARALLEL_THRESHOLD, false));
        assert!(should_parallelize(DEFAULT_PARALLEL_THRESHOLD * 2, false));
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_parallel_threshold_boundary() {
        assert_eq!(select_exec_path(DEFAULT_PARALLEL_THRESHOLD - 1, true, true), ExecPath::Simd);
        assert_eq!(select_exec_path(DEFAULT_PARALLEL_THRESHOLD, true, true), ExecPath::Parallel);
    }
}
```
